class.name: InputActionRebinder
class.brief_description: Captures the next input of the player, filters it and binds it to an action through [InputMapSettingsServer].

method.name: begin
method.description: Starts waiting for the input that becomes event [param event_index] of [param action] and emits [signal started]. [param event_index] counts the events of the action in the device class of [member device_filter]: keys and mouse buttons together for [constant DEVICE_KEYBOARD_MOUSE], joypad buttons and axes for [constant DEVICE_GAMEPAD], all events for [constant DEVICE_ANY]. It matches a column of a menu such as "Keyboard 1", "Keyboard 2" and "Gamepad". An index behind the last event adds the event at the end. A session that is still active is canceled first ([signal canceled]). Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if there is no such action, [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] if [InputMapSettingsServer] does not store the action in its [member InputMapSettingsServer.save_mode] (a built-in [code]ui_*[/code] action in [constant InputMapSettingsServer.SAVE_MODE_CUSTOM_ONLY]), and [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for a negative index.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Ends the session without a change and emits [signal canceled]. Also closes an open conflict of [constant CONFLICT_ASK]. Does nothing if no session is active.

method.name: get_action
method.description: Returns the action of the active session, or an empty [StringName] if no session is active.

method.name: get_conflict_event
method.description: Returns the event of the last conflict of the active session in its stored form (see [method InputMapSettingsServer.get_event_label] for the text of a menu), or [code]null[/code] if there was none. Use it in [signal conflict] to show a question such as "Space is already used by Jump".

method.name: get_event_index
method.description: Returns the event index of the active session, or [code]-1[/code] if no session is active.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] between [method begin] and the end of the session ([signal completed] or [signal canceled]).

method.name: is_conflict_pending
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a conflict of [constant CONFLICT_ASK] waits for [method resolve_conflict_swap], [method resolve_conflict_allow] or [method cancel]. Meanwhile [method update] uses no events.

method.name: resolve_conflict_allow
method.description: Answers an open conflict of [constant CONFLICT_ASK]: the event is bound and the other actions keep it too. Emits [signal completed]. Returns [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if no conflict is open.

method.name: resolve_conflict_swap
method.description: Answers an open conflict of [constant CONFLICT_ASK] by swapping, like [constant CONFLICT_SWAP]. Emits [signal completed]. Returns [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if no conflict is open, and [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] if an action in conflict is not stored by [InputMapSettingsServer]; then the conflict stays open.

method.name: update
method.description: Gives the rebinder an input event, usually from [method Node._input]. Returns [code]true[/code] if the event was used, so the caller can mark it as handled ([method Viewport.set_input_as_handled]). Not used: events while no session is active or a conflict of [constant CONFLICT_ASK] is open, mouse motion and other events that can't be bound (touch, MIDI, actions), released keys and buttons, echo events, joypad motion weaker than [member axis_threshold], and events outside [member device_filter] or from another pad than [member gamepad_device]. A modifier key ([kbd]Shift[/kbd], [kbd]Ctrl[/kbd], [kbd]Alt[/kbd], [kbd]Meta[/kbd]) pressed on its own is used but not bound yet: if another key follows, the combination is bound ([code]PhysicalKey:Ctrl+S[/code]); if the modifier is released first, the modifier alone is bound. A usable event without conflict is bound at once and [signal completed] is emitted. With a conflict, [member conflict_mode] decides.

members.member: How far a stick or trigger must move (from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]) before its motion is bound. The direction of the axis is part of the binding ([code]JoypadMotion:LeftY-[/code] is up).
What happens if another action already uses the captured event.
Which devices are captured. It also decides how the event index of [method begin] counts and which events are compared for conflicts.
The device id of the only joypad whose input is captured, or [code]-1[/code] for any joypad. The binding itself is stored for all joypads, like [method InputMapSettingsServer.rebind] stores it.
Actions that never count as a conflict, for example the built-in [code]ui_*[/code] actions when the game does not mind that [kbd]Space[/kbd] also presses a focused button.

signal.name: canceled
signal.description: Emitted when [method cancel] ends the session, or [method begin] starts a new one while this one was active. Nothing was changed.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted when the session ended with [param event] bound to [param action]. [param event_index] is the index where the event is now, counted like in [method begin] (an index behind the last event becomes the index of the added event). [param event] is in the stored form of [InputMapSettingsServer]. It is emitted after the server changed the events and after [signal InputMapSettingsServer.action_events_changed] was emitted for every changed action (both actions on a swap). In [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE] the new binding is in [InputMap] already. Also emitted if the event was already in this slot (nothing changed, so the server emits nothing).

signal.name: conflict
signal.description: Emitted once for each other action that uses the captured event, in [constant CONFLICT_ASK] and [constant CONFLICT_REJECT] (and in [constant CONFLICT_SWAP] if the other action can't be changed, which is then handled like [constant CONFLICT_REJECT]). [param source_action] and [param source_event_index] are the slot being rebound, [param dest_action] and [param dest_event_index] the slot of the other action that has the event, counted like in [method begin]. [method get_conflict_event] returns the event.

signal.name: started
signal.description: Emitted by [method begin] when the rebinder starts waiting for the input of [param action]. A menu shows "Press a key..." here.

constants.constant: Keys, mouse buttons, joypad buttons and joypad axes are captured. the event index of [method begin] counts all events of the action.
Only keys and mouse buttons are captured; the event index of [method begin] counts the key and mouse button events of the action together.
Only joypad buttons and axes are captured (of [member gamepad_device], if set); the event index of [method begin] counts the joypad events of the action.
[signal conflict] is emitted and the rebinder waits for the decision of the menu: [method resolve_conflict_swap], [method resolve_conflict_allow] or [method cancel].
[signal conflict] is emitted, nothing is bound and the rebinder waits for another input.

The event is bound, and the other action gets the old event of the slot in exchange (if the slot was empty, the other action only loses the event). Both actions change in one step of [InputMapSettingsServer]: one apply and one save. If more than one action uses the event, the first gets the old event and the others lose it. An action the server does not store can't be changed; then it is handled like [constant CONFLICT_REJECT].
The event is bound and the other actions keep it too; no [signal conflict] is emitted.
